equatorial-guinea.title: Flag of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea

colors.note: Top band representing the country's natural resources and forests.
Bottom band honouring the struggle for independence.
Hoist-side triangle evoking the sea linking mainland and islands.
Used in the central coat of arms with a silk-cotton tree.

desc:
- Three equal horizontal bands of green, white and red with a blue triangle at the hoist
- The national coat of arms is centred on the white band
- The arms feature a silk-cotton tree, six stars and the motto Unidad, Paz, Justicia
trivia:
- The six stars on the arms represent the mainland (Río Muni) and five inhabited islands
- The silk-cotton tree in the arms is the one under which the first treaty with Spain was signed
- Flown without the arms from 1973 until 1979 under dictator Francisco Macías Nguema
